description: The University of Deusto publishes an R notebook demonstrating clustering of household electricity-consumption patterns. The Zenodo package contains the notebook and sixty selected files from the GoiEner dataset, with links to a hosted notebook and a detailed recorded explanation. Although the repository classifies the deposit as a presentation, it supplies executable source and illustrative inputs. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the selected Spanish load profiles, not an independently sampled population. Cluster assignments could inform heterogeneous household agents or representative demand profiles for simulations with model-pypsa, using data-goiener-smart-meter-data-spain as the larger source. A caveat is that the landing description does not establish the stability or representativeness of the clusters. The notebook was not run, and the example meter data were not downloaded.
